names.en: Secluded Domain of Heaven and Earth

summary.text: A secluded domain of heaven and earth is a famous, named place of the world, often recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu, dense with a path's dao marks and able to sit inside an immortal aperture.

claims.text: Mo Yao names the Door of Life and Death as a secluded domain of heaven and earth, very famous and recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu. In the current era that door has vanished, and after going through numerous owners its control over souls of the demised has weakened greatly, which is given as a reason zombies can exist.
That class of world domains is distinct from the true inheritance secluded domain inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

Miniscule Mountain is a secluded domain of heaven and earth recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu. The mountain itself has a large number of dao marks. Fairy Li Shan places it inside her own immortal aperture so those dao marks become her foundation and she can use and expend them.

City Well, Reverse Flow River, and Luo Po Valley are three secluded domains of heaven and earth that cause a huge burden on a blessed land: expenditure of heaven and earth qi is intense, and the owner must absorb heaven and earth qi from the outside world to replenish them from time to time. Sovereign blessed land can handle the weight of four such domains; ordinary blessed lands cannot sustain two of them at once.

The River of Time can be said to be the most special secluded domain of heaven and earth. It traverses the entire world; without its existence and movement the Gu Master world would become a still picture without changes or vitality. Fang Yuan can seize domains such as Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley as his own, but he absolutely cannot seize the whole River of Time. That domain belongs to all beings of the world, and even Gu Immortals can at most possess a tributary of it in their immortal aperture. It is the area with the greatest amount of time path dao marks in the whole world.

A complete Reverse Flow River, as a secluded domain of heaven and earth, is equivalent to rank nine in quantity of dao marks, and that density can sometimes let such a domain be used as a quasi-rank nine Immortal Gu. Secluded domains of heaven and earth are not Immortal Gu: Immortal Gu are alive and can be used fully when immortal essence is transferred into them, while secluded domains are non-living and their usage is limited. An Immortal Gu is a connected body of fragments of dao marks; a secluded domain is an amalgamation of countless dao marks piled in many shapes and relations, so there is no way to make use of all of them.

A secluded domain of heaven and earth is an agglomeration of dao marks of a specific path forming a certain special effect. Dang Hun Mountain produces guts Gu, while Qian Kun Crystal Wall can reflect everything that happens in this world. Secluded domains of heaven and earth are the extreme form of resource points, and the other aspect of Gu worms and killer moves.
Super resource points sit at rank eight level, and the pinnacle resource points are those secluded domains of heaven and earth.
